name: Clofenciclan
summary: Clofenciclan is a dopamine-releasing agent developed by Boehringer & Soehne in the 1950s. It proved unpopular as a treatment because of its pronounced stimulant activity.

pharmacology.text: Clofenciclan (also known as chlorphencyclan; trade names Tonquil and Vesitan) is a dopamine-releasing agent developed by Boehringer & Soehne in the 1950s.

uses.text: Clofenciclan (also known as chlorphencyclan; trade names Tonquil and Vesitan) is a dopamine-releasing agent developed by Boehringer & Soehne in the 1950s. It proved unpopular as a treatment because of its pronounced stimulant activity.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of its kind can cause sleeplessness, restlessness, anxiety, a fast heartbeat, high blood pressure and loss of appetite, and can lead to dependence. High amounts can cause overheating, paranoia, psychosis and seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能造成失眠、坐立不安、焦慮、心跳加快、血壓升高與食慾減退，並可能導致依賴。大量使用可能造成體溫過高、妄想、精神病症狀與癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能造成失眠、坐立不安、焦虑、心跳加快、血压升高与食欲减退，并可能导致依赖。大量使用可能造成体温过高、妄想、精神病症状与癫痫发作。

fact.en: It was developed by C. F. Boehringer & Soehne of Mannheim, Germany, a company later known as Boehringer Mannheim, which became part of Roche in the 1990s.
fact.zh: 它由德國曼海姆的 C. F. Boehringer & Soehne 公司研發，這家公司後來稱為寶靈曼（Boehringer Mannheim），並在 1990 年代併入羅氏。
fact.zhHans: 它由德国曼海姆的 C. F. Boehringer & Soehne 公司研发，这家公司后来称为宝灵曼（Boehringer Mannheim），并在 1990 年代并入罗氏。
